evals.prompt: Get me all the buildings in Lyon 2e from Overture as a file I can open in QGIS.
expected_behavior: Uses a bbox for the area instead of a country download
Uses the overturemaps CLI or reads the latest release from the STAC catalog
Writes GeoPackage or GeoParquet and reports feature count and extent
Gives the ODbL credit line for Overture buildings
must_not: Hardcodes an old Overture release path

evals.prompt: I converted my GeoPackage to shapefile for a client and now some columns have weird names.
expected_behavior: Explains the 10-character field name limit of Shapefile
Suggests GeoPackage, or explicit field mapping before export

evals.prompt: My CSV of GPS points shows up off the coast of Somalia instead of France.
expected_behavior: Identifies swapped lat and lon columns
Shows how to load the CSV with the right X and Y columns and EPSG:4326

evals.prompt: J'ai un shapefile sans .prj avec des coordonnées autour de 650000, 6860000. Quel EPSG ?
expected_behavior: Recognizes values typical of Lambert-93 (EPSG:2154) in France and states it as an assumption to confirm
Assigns the CRS (relabel) instead of reprojecting

evals.prompt: Can I sell a map product built on OSM roads merged with my own data?
expected_behavior: Says commercial use is allowed under ODbL
Explains the share-alike duty for a publicly used derived database
Gives the credit line '© OpenStreetMap contributors'
must_not: Says attribution alone is enough for the merged database
